behaviour.title: Website behaviour
behaviour.sub: Where visitors click, how far they scroll and which form fields they leave empty.

heat.title: Click map
heat.sub: Darker spots are where more people clicked. The map is the whole length of the page, top to bottom.

reach.title: How far they scroll
reach.sub: Of everyone who opened the page, the share who got this far down. Uses the page and device chosen above.

fields.title: Form fields left empty
fields.sub: Only the field's name is kept, never what was typed. A high number means people stop at that field.

buttons.title: Button clicks
